reason: Quality review must apply shared cross-layer and reuse checks.
Review contract strictness and bounds against package conventions.
Review sensitive response DTO and client wrapper strictness.
Review middleware order, body budgets, route inventory, and HTTP tests.
Review auth token propagation and client compatibility.
Check security acceptance criteria and verify deferred rate limiting is not accidentally implemented.
Check exact-origin, cookie/session, and no-oracle invariants.
Check migration and future-task scope boundaries.
